unconfirmed: The Machina compute (#/compute) and the Arca market (#/market) are suggested wording: their titles ('Local AI hardware, sized to the work.', 'Compute for a private AI.', 'The market, by tier.', 'Size a private AI.', 'Gold coins and art, to keep.', 'The Arca market.', 'Gold coins, against the gold inside.', 'Art, by invitation.', 'How a request works.'), leads, supply words ('On allocation', 'To order', 'In stock', 'Short', 'Used market'), calculator questions and answers, buttons ('See the compute', 'Ask to source', 'Add to basket', 'Sourcing only', 'See the market', 'Ask about the art') and request steps.

The calculator is an estimate, and its method is suggested (site/shop.json → machina.calc): model weights at 4-bit (8B-class 5 GB, 32B-class 20 GB, 70B-class 40 GB); working memory per person answered at once (1, 2 and 2.5 GB); 6 GB more for speech and 16 GB for images; 1.2 times for overhead; 1, 3, 8 and 25 people at once for the four team sizes; each build's ceiling on cards per machine and people served. Costs cover the cards only, at the market ranges shown.

The basket now serves all three wings: the label 'Basket', the empty line naming the three markets, 'A line marked “by email” is priced in our reply.', 'By email' on request lines, and the order email's 'Order for lastfomo' and 'Priced by email' are suggested wording.
Roadmap 'Next' items (more private builds; pilot beds to full farms; a private catalogue by invitation) were written as plausible directions.
'What happens next' steps on Start a project (we read the brief; a short call; a written plan) are suggested wording.

Field-note captions now follow the ledger wording ('over about 250 years', 'Renaissance, embossed and gilt steel, made for display', dosing channels 'Visible on the feeding rig'); the shipped page had looser wording.
Brief sending states on Start a project ('Sending…'; 'Brief sent.'; 'It is on its way to lastfomo@gmail.com.') are suggested wording, added when the form began emailing the brief.

Explore (#/explore, site/explore.js) is suggested interface wording: the settings ('Auto walk', 'Visits every signal for you, wing by wing.', 'Music', 'The score of each wing.', 'Sounds', 'Steps, signals and arches.', 'Look with your phone', 'Walk to', 'How to walk'), the toasts ('Auto walk is on.
